operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for this flight, and all available information is processed (milestone 1).

operations.name: commenceDpiProcess
operations.description: The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations (if implemented) (milestone 1).

operations.name: calculateTobtFromEldt
operations.description: Update of the ELDT can trigger a new TOBT to be entered by the AO/GH, or calculated automatically by the Airport CDM Platform (milestone 4).

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent (milestone 1).

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight (milestone 1).

operations.name: sendFirstEDpi
operations.description: The E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided; the AO must provide correct information before this message, feeding Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data as early as possible (milestone 1).

operations.name: initiateOutboundFlight
operations.description: For non coordinated airports, the flight plan is used to initiate the outbound flight (milestone 1).

operations.name: checkFlightReadiness
operations.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateArrivalTimings
operations.description: ELDT and EIBT updated for an arrival (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateDepartureTimings
operations.description: EOBT and ETOT updated for a departure (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateAircraftType
operations.description: The flight plan may be used to update certain information such as type of aircraft (milestone 1).

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: The ATC Flight Plan is submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS; all involved ATC units receive the flight plan, including departure and destination aerodromes (milestone 1).

operations.name: issueCtot
operations.description: If the flight is regulated, a CTOT is issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2h and is sent to relevant ATS units as well as the departure aerodrome (milestone 2).

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, before or after take off from outstation, to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan estimated off block time at EOBT-2 hrs (milestone 2).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsWithTDpi
operations.description: At EOBT-2 hrs Network Operations is informed through the first T-DPI message about the updated take off time estimate (milestone 2).

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: ETOT/TTOT/CTOT are updated and appropriate fields are marked as REGULATED (milestone 2).

operations.name: updateFromFum
operations.description: For inbound flights, ELDT is updated based on information provided by the FUM messages, taking into account the actual progress of the flight (milestone 2).

operations.name: calculateFromAtot
operations.description: If the departure airport is more than 3hrs flying time from the destination airport, using the ATOT an ELDT can be calculated using the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL (milestone 3).

operations.name: calculateAtEobtMinus2Hr
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT. In the case of manual input of TOBT, this estimate will override the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (milestone 2).

operations.name: calculateAtTakeOffFromOutstation
operations.description: Calculation basis for the TTOT shall take into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT. In case EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT. In the case where TOBT is available this prediction will overrule the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (milestone 3).

operations.name: updateConsideringExot
operations.description: TTOT updated considering the EXOT (milestone 15).

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take off from outstation are consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan, to verify feasibility of the ATC Flight Plan at take off from outstation (milestone 3).

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsWithTDpiT
operations.description: When needed, informs Network Operations about the updated take off time estimates using a T-DPI-t Message; a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before Network Operations is informed of the updated TTOT (milestone 3).

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: If the flight is within 3hrs flying time of the destination airport, Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using the ETFMS (milestone 3).

operations.name: sendFlightUpdateMessage
operations.description: Network Operations sends a Flight Update Message (FUM) that provides updates of the flight's progress (milestone 3).

operations.name: detectFlightBySsr
operations.description: The radar system is able to detect a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when the flight crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary (milestone 4).

operations.name: detectFinalApproach
operations.description: The radar system detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code and identifies when the flight crosses either a defined range/position or passes/leaves a predetermined level (milestone 5).

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 4).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; the TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed of updated TTOT (milestone 4).

operations.name: calculateFromEldt
operations.description: An estimated in-block time (EIBT) is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time (milestone 4).

operations.name: updateFromAldt
operations.description: The EIBT can be updated according to the ALDT+EXIT (milestone 6).

operations.name: checkStandGateChangeAllowed
operations.description: Taking into account the taxi-in time (EXIT), any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30' (milestone 4).

operations.name: commenceTobtProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 5).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; the TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed of updated TTOT (milestone 5).

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan (milestone 6).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 6).

operations.name: provideActualLandingTime
operations.description: ALDT is provided by ATC system or by ACARS from equipped aircraft (milestone 6).

operations.name: provideActualInBlockTime
operations.description: AIBT is provided by ACARS equipped aircraft or automated docking systems or ATC systems (e.g. A-SMGCS) or by manual input (milestone 7).

operations.name: calculateExot
operations.description: Following the receipt of the TOBT, the ATC system will calculate and provide the Estimated Taxi-Out Time (EXOT) based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position (milestone 9).

operations.name: provideActualOffBlockTime
operations.description: AOBT is provided by ACARS equipped aircraft or automated docking systems or ATC systems (e.g. A-SMGCS) or by manual input (milestone 15).

operations.name: provideActualTakeOffTime
operations.description: ATOT is provided by ATC system or from ACARS equipped aircraft (milestone 16).

operations.name: calculateDepartingFlightTimings
operations.description: TOBT and TTOT are updated automatically or inserted manually by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler, calculated on the basis of the defined or estimated turn-round period for the departing flight (milestones 6, 7, 8).

operations.name: deriveFromAibt
operations.description: ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT for a normal turn-round (milestone 7).

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan (milestone 7).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 7).

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan (milestone 8).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 8).

operations.name: checkTobtConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, performed at a predefined time (local parameter) to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue (milestone 9).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance; a TTOT tolerance is respected before Network Operations is informed on updated TTOT (milestone 9).

operations.name: confirmTobtPriorToTsat
operations.description: The confirmed TOBT prior to TSAT has special status, where AO/GH check the quality of TOBT before TSAT issue; no need to confirm an existing TOBT if it has been manually modified before (milestone 9).

operations.name: addFlight
operations.description: The flight is introduced into the pre-departure sequence following receipt of TOBT (milestone 9).

operations.name: resequenceFlight
operations.description: In case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, the flight will be re-sequenced (milestone 14).

operations.name: removeFlight
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence (milestone 16).

operations.name: issueTsat
operations.description: ATC issues TSAT t-minutes before EOBT, where t is a parameter agreed locally (milestone 10).

operations.name: informPartnersOfTsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT that has been allocated to the flight; the TSAT will indicate to the partners the time when the start up approval can be expected (milestone 10).

operations.name: sendTDpiS
operations.description: Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non regulated flights; no check is performed for this step (milestone 10).

operations.name: checkTobtUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates exceeds a tolerance defined locally, after TSAT has been issued; in case the number exceeds a threshold, the TOBT input should be processed according to local procedure (milestone 10).

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsbt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time (ASBT) when it occurs (milestone 11).

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain time before TOBT (local variable e.g. corresponding to aircraft type) a check shall be performed to check the boarding status and inform the AO/GH in case TOBT needs to be updated (milestone 11).

operations.name: informPartnersOfArdt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time (ARDT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft is ready for start up/push-back (milestone 12).

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance the AO/GH are informed that TOBT has passed and there has not been a ready status message yet (milestone 12).

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsrt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start up Request Time (ASRT) in the Airport CDM Platform when it occurs (milestone 13).

operations.name: checkStartUpRequestedInTime
operations.description: If the start up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, the AO/GH is informed that no start up has been requested, and should update TOBT (milestone 13).

operations.name: informPartnersOfAsat
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual start up approval Time (ASAT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has received start up approval/push-back clearance, when it occurs (milestone 14).

operations.name: checkAsatAgainstTsat
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance to TSAT and alerts all relevant Airport CDM Partners when no start up has been granted; in case the start up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners should be informed (milestone 14).

operations.name: informPartnersOfAobt
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time (AOBT) in the Airport CDM Platform and that the aircraft has commenced push-back/taxi from parking position, when it occurs (milestone 15).

operations.name: sendADpi
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations or, in the case of remote holding, at a defined time prior to TTOT (milestone 15).

operations.name: checkTtotToleranceAndNotify
operations.description: After a first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT (milestone 15).

operations.name: informPartnersOfTakeOff
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off (milestone 16).

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: An airborne message is generated (milestone 16).

operations.name: sendFsaAndMvt
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent (milestone 16).
